# NotchDock

> NotchDock transforms your MacBook screen notch into an intelligent live update hub and silent notification center for real-time sports scores, intraday stock watchlists, clipboard history, meeting countdowns, and media controls — engineered for macOS power users who want ambient status updates without noisy notification banners or menu bar clutter.

NotchDock is a lightweight macOS desktop utility application that lives in the hardware notch cutout area of Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) and Intel MacBooks. It gives users glanceable micro-status indicators and immediate hover-to-reveal access to rich interactive widgets without consuming screen real estate, sending disruptive popup alerts, or transmitting user telemetry off-device.

## Core Pillars: Intelligent Notifications & Live Activities

- **Intelligent Ambient Notifications**: Replaces disruptive top-right macOS notification banners with silent pulse dots, status tickers, and glanceable indicators inside the camera bezel.
- **Always-On Live Activities**: Automated real-time score feeds for Premier League, Champions League, NFL, NBA, MLB, and intraday stock/crypto sparklines (S&P 500, NASDAQ, Bitcoin).
- **Hover-Activated Productivity Tray**: Hover your mouse over the screen notch to instantly reveal full scoreboards, candlestick charts, clipboard snippet history, Pomodoro timers, and universal media controls.
- **100% Local & Privacy-First**: Zero cloud telemetry, zero accounts, and zero data tracking. All clipboard snippets and watchlist holdings remain strictly on your Mac.

## Installation & System Requirements

- [Download Installer DMG](https://github.com/rohanrony/notchdock/releases): Download the latest packaged `NotchDock.dmg` installer for macOS.
- **System Requirements**: Requires macOS Monterey (12.0) or newer (macOS Ventura, macOS Sonoma, macOS Sequoia compatible). Works on both Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) and Intel Macs.
- **Installation Steps**:
  1. Open `NotchDock.dmg` and drag `NotchDock.app` to your `/Applications` folder.
  2. Launch `NotchDock.app`.
  3. Grant macOS Accessibility permissions in System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Accessibility (required for detecting hover position around the MacBook notch).
  4. Move your mouse cursor to the top center of your display near the notch to reveal the utility dock.

## Privacy & Security

- **100% Local Execution**: NotchDock operates strictly locally on your Mac. No clipboard text, stock holdings, personal notes, or telemetry are ever uploaded or transmitted off device.
